cards.ex: The rebels were armed to the teeth, ready for anything.
cards.exUz: Isyonchilar juda yaxshi qurollangan, har qanday narsaga tayyor edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p qurolli, juda yaxshi qurollangan.

cards.ex: The debate turned into a war of words between the two politicians.
cards.exUz: Debat ikki siyosatchi o'rtasida so'z urushiga aylanib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Og'zaki bahs yoki qattiq tanqidiy munozara.

cards.ex: The general dug in his heels, refusing to negotiate with the enemy.
cards.exUz: General dushmanni muzokara qilishdan bosh tortib, oyoq tirab turdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qat'iy qarshi turish, o'z fikrida qolish.

cards.ex: We had to bite the bullet and cut military spending.
cards.exUz: Biz harbiy xarajatlarni qisqartirishga majbur bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatga chidash, noqulaylikka sabr qilish.

cards.ex: The commander calls the shots in the field.
cards.exUz: Dala maydonida qo'mondon qarorlar qabul qiladi.

cards.ex: Soldiers must fall in line with orders.
cards.exUz: Askarlar buyruqlarga rioya qilishlari kerak.

cards.ex: The captain ordered them to hold their fire until they had a clear target.
cards.exUz: Kapitan aniq nishonga ega bo'lmaguncha o't ochishni to'xtatishga buyruq berdi.

cards.ex: The senator found himself in the crosshairs after his controversial statement.
cards.exUz: Senator bahsli bayonotidan keyin nishonda qoldi.

cards.ex: The peace dividend allowed the government to invest in education and healthcare.
cards.exUz: Tinchlik foydasi hukumatga ta'lim va sog'liqni saqlashga sarmoya kiritishga imkon berdi.

cards.ex: The region is a powder keg, with tensions rising every day.
cards.exUz: Mintaqa portlashga tayyor porox bochkasi, har kuni keskinlik ortib bormoqda.

cards.ex: The military strategy was based on shock and awe.
cards.exUz: Harbiy strategiya qo'rqitish taktikasiga asoslangan edi.
cards.uzDef: Dushmanni tezda mag'lub etish uchun kuchli hujum.

cards.ex: The country is on a war footing after the attack.
cards.exUz: Hujumdan so'ng mamlakat urush holatida.

cards.ex: The Cold War was characterized by a dangerous arms race.
cards.exUz: Sovuq urush xavfli qurollanish poygasi bilan ajralib turardi.

cards.ex: The general was a battle-hardened veteran.
cards.exUz: General urushda toblangan faxriy edi.

cards.ex: The debate was full of cut and thrust arguments.
cards.exUz: Debat qaytarmoq va sanchmoq argumentlar bilan to'la edi.

cards.ex: The declaration of war shocked the world.
cards.exUz: Urush e'loni dunyoni hayratda qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Davlatning boshqa davlatga urush e'lon qilishi.

cards.ex: During the air raid drills, the children were taught to duck and cover.
cards.exUz: Havo hujumi mashqlari paytida bolalarga yashirinish o'rgatildi.

cards.ex: Some people believe in an eye for an eye.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi odamlar qasos olishga ishonishadi.
cards.uzDef: Qasos olish, bir xil javob qaytarish.

cards.ex: They were fighting a losing battle against the superior forces.
cards.exUz: Ular ustun kuchlarga qarshi befoyda kurashayotgan edi.

cards.ex: He served on the front line for two years.
cards.exUz: U ikki yil davomida front chizig'ida xizmat qildi.

cards.ex: The soldiers came in, guns blazing.
cards.exUz: Askarlar o'q otib kirib kelishdi.

cards.ex: The president declared 'mission accomplished' after the capture of the city.
cards.exUz: Prezident shaharni egallab olgandan so'ng 'vazifa bajarildi' deb e'lon qildi.

cards.ex: They had to cross no man's land to reach the enemy trenches.
cards.exUz: Dushman xandaqlariga yetib borish uchun hech kimniki bo'lmagan yerdan o'tishlari kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki tomon o'rtasida joylashgan xavfli hudud.

cards.ex: The negotiations are on a knife-edge.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar qil ustida turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatda, muvozanatni yo'qotish xavfi ostida.

cards.ex: The government is trying to initiate peace talks.
cards.exUz: Hukumat tinchlik muzokaralarini boshlashga harakat qilmoqda.

cards.ex: The shock troops led the assault on the enemy stronghold.
cards.exUz: Zarba beruvchi qo'shinlar dushman tayanch punktiga hujumni boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Hujumda birinchi bo'lib boruvchi maxsus qo'shinlar.

cards.ex: The military has a zero tolerance policy for drug use.
cards.exUz: Harbiylarda giyohvand moddalarni iste'mol qilishga nol tolerantlik siyosati mavjud.

cards.ex: The politician came under fire for his controversial statements.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi bahsli bayonotlari uchun tanqidga uchradi.

cards.ex: The villagers decided to take up arms to defend their homes.
cards.exUz: Qishloq aholisi uylarini himoya qilish uchun qurol olishga qaror qildi.

cards.ex: He was labeled a draft dodger during the Vietnam War.
cards.exUz: U Vetnam urushi paytida chaqiruvdan qochuvchi deb belgilandi.
